note: Humane Shuttle passenger chatter. Each faction has lines by mood: praise (smooth driving), heckle (rough driving: walls, hard corners, brake slams), joke (random, any time), board (getting on), late (over par). 'riders' is who gets on in the Sprawls vs. the city. Add lines freely; the game picks at random and avoids repeats.

sprawl.label: SQUALOR RESIDENT
praise: Smooth. Smoother than my last landlord, anyway.
Oi, this one can actually drive!
Ma, look, no bruises!
I could sleep on this. I might. Wake me at the Spine.
Best ride I've had since the war. Which war? Exactly.
Lovely. Like being carried by a drunk angel.
Didn't spill a drop of my soup. Respect.
You drive like you've got somewhere to be and someone to love.
Gentle as a Null Sector drone. Kidding. Gentler.
If this is humane, I'll take seconds.
heckle: Jesus wept, who gave YOU a licence?
My spine! And not the nice one with the shops!
Driving like the shuttle owes you money.
Oi! Precious cargo back here! Mostly me!
I've had smoother rides in a bin. I've lived in a bin.
Mind the wall, you absolute walnut!
Christ on a cargo pallet!
Are you steering or just suggesting?
That's my kidney on the window now, cheers.
Brakes are on the floor, genius. The FLOOR.
I paid nothing for this ride and I want a refund.
Do you hate us specifically or people in general?
Fuck me, it's like riding a shopping trolley down a mineshaft.
Holy hell, I've lost a shoe. I only had the one.
If I puke, it's going on your dashboard, mate.
joke: Why'd the scrapper cross the void? Rent was due on both sides.
My hut's so small I have to go outside to change my mind.
They call it the Sprawl because nobody can afford to stand up.
I asked the Ministry for a home. They sent a pamphlet. I'm living in it.
What's the difference between a squatter and a landlord? About 1.25 times.
Knock knock. Who's there? Eviction. Eviction who? Exactly.
My neighbour burns tyres for warmth. Cosy. Toxic, but cosy.
I was going to get a job but this shuttle's warmer.
Heard the void whale's back. Bring a bucket, it's payday.
They say money can't buy happiness. Haven't seen either, can't confirm.
Life hack: if you stand still long enough, the Registry assigns you a number.
My lean-to has a sea view. The sea is slag. Still counts.
board: Room for one more? Room for one more.
Is this the one to the Spine? Is anything?
Mind if I bring my chicken? It's mostly feathers now.
Morning. Or whatever this is.
Don't look at me, I've got a ticket. Somewhere.
Budge up, I'm a big lad.
late: Clock's running, love. Like my nose.
My shift started an hour ago. I don't have a shift. Still.
At this rate my hut'll be rezoned before we arrive.
We're late. Again. Brilliant. Classic.
Could've crawled there. Could've crawled there TWICE.

vanta.label: VANTABLACK ASSOCIATE
praise: Adequate. I'll note it in your file. Positively, for once.
Acceptable ride-to-cost ratio. Well done.
Smooth. Like a well-structured loan.
heckle: This vehicle is collateral, you know. Drive like it.
Every bump is going on your account.
I've seen better handling on a defaulted mortgage.
Do that again and we're repossessing your teeth.
Christ, man, I bill by the minute and this is costing ME.
joke: We don't own the void. We just hold the paper on it.
Science Centre says EVA is 'promising'. Promising what, they won't say.
Interest compounds. So does resentment. Both are profitable.
board: Associate class, please. Oh. There is no associate class.
I'm only on this vehicle for research purposes.
late: Late is a breach. I'll draft something.
Tick tock. Every second is a fee.

kessler.label: KESSLER MINER
praise: Nice and steady. Like a good drill bit.
You'd do alright in the deep shafts, kid.
Smooth as fresh ore. Well. Smoother.
heckle: I've been in cave-ins with less shaking!
You fly like a loose payload, ya muppet!
Bloody hell, I came up here to get AWAY from rockfalls.
Ease off, I've got dynamite in me lunchbox. Joking. Mostly.
Shit the bed, that was a wall!
joke: Everything's ore eventually. Even you. Especially you.
Why do miners make good friends? We dig you.
Refit Bay quoted me 300 scrap for a gyro. I'll gyro their nose.
That debris field? Ours. Business was slow.
board: Mind the dust, it's load-bearing.
Shift's over. Thank Christ.
late: We're slower than a dull bit in granite.
I've mined faster than this. With a spoon.

ashiron.label: ASH & IRON FAITHFUL
praise: Blessed be the steady hand.
A smooth ride is a form of prayer.
The quota of comfort is met. Praise.
heckle: Lord of the furnace, take the wheel from this heathen!
Your driving is a sin and I will be mentioning it at vespers.
Damn your soul and your suspension!
The smog is gentler than you, brother.
I'll hymn your name at the next smelting. Not kindly.
joke: Production is prayer. Overtime is a pilgrimage.
Our smog is trademarked. Breathe it and you owe us.
How many Ash & Iron workers to change a lamp? None. Quota says darkness.
board: Shift ends with the hymn. The hymn never ends.
Brother. Sister. Driver.
late: The quota does not wait, brother.
Late! The foreman will sing of this.

null.label: NULL SECTOR OFFICER
praise: Driving within acceptable parameters. Carry on, citizen.
Compliant. Nice.
I'm not writing you up. Today.
heckle: That was a moving violation, citizen. Several, in fact.
One more wall and I'm impounding the lot of us.
Do you WANT a pursuit? Because that's how you get a pursuit.
Driving's shit, driver's shit, day's shit. Carry on.
I'm off duty, but I'm noting your skiff number.
joke: Null Sector: protection, and protection from Null Sector.
We're paid per capture. Drive however you like.
Our drones don't sleep. Neither do I. Hence the mood.
board: Off duty. Mostly. Don't test it.
Nobody sits next to me. Good.
late: Late is suspicious behaviour, citizen.
I'll be logging this delay.

cinder.label: CINDER METER READER
praise: Lovely, you're barely using any air back here.
Smooth driving saves oxygen. I've done the maths.
Efficient. I like efficient.
heckle: Every time you hit something we all gasp. That's metered, you know.
You're costing us litres of air, mate.
Breathe responsibly! You're not letting us!
Oh for fuck's sake, I dropped my meter.
joke: Air is metered. Jokes are free. For now.
Inhale. Exhale. That'll be four scrap.
Why did the meter reader quit? Couldn't take the pressure.
board: Reading your meter on the way, if you don't mind.
Morning. Breathe light.
late: Late costs air. Air costs money. Do the maths.

gullet.label: GULLET VAT HAND
praise: Smooth enough to eat soup. I'm eating soup.
Didn't lose a single ration brick. Chef's kiss.
You drive like a well-proofed loaf.
heckle: My lunch is in my lap now. Thanks.
Protein slurry on the ceiling. Again.
You've curdled my vat culture, you prick!
Easy! I'm carrying the good bricks!
joke: Calories are a privilege. So's this seat.
The restaurant's members-only. The members are the vats.
What's in the ration bricks? Yes.
board: Anyone want a brick? No? More for me.
Smells like vats. That's me.
late: The vats are boiling over without me!

lastmile.label: LAST MILE CONTRACTOR
praise: Five stars. Not that it pays you anything.
Clean delivery of humans. Love to see it.
Mate, you should drive for us. Actually don't, it's awful.
heckle: I'd dock you a star but I'm not allowed to give any.
Driving like you're paid per crash.
Cargo's insured. I'm not. EASE UP.
Who taught you corners, the void?
joke: Independent contractor means I'm independently broke.
We own no ships, employ no pilots, and somehow I'm still tired.
Last Mile? It's always the last mile. Every mile.
board: Between gigs. Always between gigs.
Got a parcel? I'll take it. For a fee.
late: Late? Your rating's gonna tank, mate.
That's a missed SLA right there.

gavel.label: GAVEL & ROPE BIDDER
praise: Going once, going twice, SOLD on this smooth ride.
I'd bid on this driver.
Lovely work. Lot thirteen, the driver.
heckle: I've seen dormant skiffs handle better!
Your licence is going up for auction, pal.
Sixty-nine hours till I forgive that.
Bloody hell, do we have a reserve price on our lives?
joke: All auctions last 69 hours. Nice.
We don't sell numbers. We release them. For money.
I bought a used skiff number. Previous owner's ghost included.
board: Any bids on that seat? No? Mine.
Lot one: me, sitting down.
late: Late! The hammer's falling without me!

mercy.label: MERCY UNLIMITED NURSE
praise: Lovely driving. Nobody needs me. A first.
Smooth ride. Mercy approves.
No injuries! Bad for business, good for you.
heckle: Keep this up and I'll be billing ALL of you.
That one's going in a report. A medical one.
I can hear somebody's ribs. Not mine. Yet.
Fuck me, I'm off shift. Don't make me work.
joke: We heal you, bury you, and sponsor the race in between.
The Spine Run sponsor-of-record gets paid per crash. Guess who.
Mercy Unlimited: unlimited, except for the mercy.
board: Mind the kit, there's sharps in there.
Night shift. Or day. Who knows.
late: Patients waiting. Some of them breathing.

ministry.label: MINISTRY CLERK
praise: Exemplary. I'll put in a good word with the Directorate.
This is what humane transit looks like.
You'll make Route Steward yet, my lad.
heckle: The Directorate will hear about this. In triplicate.
Humane, they said. HUMANE.
I'm filing a complaint. Then I'm processing it. Then I'm upholding it.
Damned conductors. Damned shuttles. Damned Tuesday.
joke: Getting the people where the gentry need them. It's on the side of the bus.
The Ministry is in a heat zone. For our safety. Not yours.
I processed thirteen forms today. Twelve were mine.
board: Ministry business. Don't ask.
Here's my pass. It's laminated.
late: This delay will need a form. Form 13-L.

assessor.label: ASSESSOR'S APPRAISER
praise: I assess this ride at 1.25 times expectations.
Valuation: excellent. Rare word for me.
heckle: This ride has depreciated considerably.
I'm marking your driving down. Way down.
Even I can't put a value on that crash. Negative, probably.
joke: Everything is worth 1.25 times what you paid. Even this joke.
Nobody reads the ledger. That's how we like it.
board: Just appraising the seats. Carry on.
late: Time is money. You are losing both.

registry.label: REGISTRY CLERK
praise: Good driving. I'll remember your number. I remember all the numbers.
Smooth. Soul intact.
heckle: Careful, I'd hate to have to announce your number.
You're one wall away from a death certificate, pal.
Shit driving, citizen. Logged.
joke: We don't sell numbers. We just release them after thirteen days of silence.
Skiffs and Souls. Mostly skiffs.
board: Number? I'll find it. I always find it.
late: Thirteen minutes late. I'm counting.

bureau.label: BUREAU CHEER OFFICER
praise: What a joyful ride! Civic Warmth for everyone!
Your cheer is noted and appreciated!
Smile! You're driving beautifully!
heckle: That was insufficiently cheerful driving.
I'm docking you warmth. With love.
Smile while you crash, please. It's policy.
Oh, for fuck's — I mean, golly!
joke: Cheer is mandatory. Joy is encouraged. Sadness is filed.
We publish this wiki. Trust us.
The Most Humane Citizen of the Day is chosen fairly. By us.
board: Hello! Hello! Everybody smile!
Bureau business. Happy business!
late: Lateness is a mood. Change your mood!
